pack.title: Unit 9.0 Evaluate Network Security Capabilities
pack.notes: Needs revision: written hands-off; Mr. Flauto has not checked it yet.

questions.stem: An audit finds that a county government's servers were each set up by a different technician, so their password, logging, and encryption settings all differ. Which of the following should the security team create so every server gets the same approved settings?

reference.title: Benchmarks and Secure Configuration Guides
reference.find: collection of standard configurations and settings

questions.stem: A security audit of a manufacturing company's new access switches finds that administrators manage them over Telnet. Which of the following hardening changes BEST addresses this finding?

choices.text: Turn on logging of failed sign-ins
Manage the switches over HTTP instead
Enable port security on every port
Manage the switches over SSH instead

reference.title: Benchmarks and Secure Configuration Guides
reference.find: such as SSH instead of Telnet

questions.stem: After a site survey of a three-story library, the heat map shows almost no signal in the back offices and two lobby WAPs covering the same area. Which of the following BEST improves the wireless design?

choices.text: Bond the lobby WAPs' channels to reach the back offices
Put both lobby WAPs on the same channel to cut interference
Lower the transmit power on both lobby WAPs to cut overlap
Move one of the lobby WAPs to cover the back offices

questions.stem: A food warehouse is adding dozens of wireless temperature sensors with Wi-Fi Protected Setup (WPS), whose PIN an attacker can brute force in a few hours. Which of the following should the network team use instead to add the sensors securely?
A security analyst reviews the configuration of the access point in a car dealership's showroom. Based on the settings shown, which of the following security issues should the analyst report?

exhibit.text:
AP name: SHOWROOM-AP1
SSID 1: Lakeside-Sales
Security 1: WEP
SSID 2: Lakeside-Guest
Security 2: Enhanced Open
Admin access: HTTPS

reference.title: Wireless Encryption
reference.find: Neither WEP nor the original WPA

questions.stem: An auditor tells a pharmacy to stop using WPA with TKIP, and the pharmacy's new access points support every Wi-Fi security standard. Which of the following should the pharmacy configure to BEST protect its wireless traffic?

reference.title: Wireless Encryption
reference.find: replaces AES CCM with the AES

questions.stem: During an assessment of an accounting office's WPA2-Personal network, a penetration tester records a laptop's successful login and then cracks the Wi-Fi password from that recording offline. Which of the following is designed to prevent this attack?

reference.title: Wireless Encryption
reference.find: capturing data from a successful login

questions.stem: A clinic's security officer worries that someone in the parking lot could capture and read the patient data staff send over the Wi-Fi. Which of the following should the access points use to BEST address this concern?

Employees at a hotel keep giving the staff Wi-Fi passphrase to guests, so the hotel wants each employee to sign in to the Wi-Fi with their own email account instead. Which of the following BEST meets this goal?

reference.title: Wi-Fi Authentication Methods
reference.find: have a unique set of credentials

questions.stem: A law firm wants its Wi-Fi logs to show exactly which attorney was connected at any time, so attorneys must not share one passphrase. Which of the following security modes BEST meets this requirement?

reference.title: Wi-Fi Authentication Methods
reference.find: track network usage at a granular

questions.stem: A security engineer at a defense contractor is setting up WPA3-Enterprise Wi-Fi and requires both the RADIUS server and every laptop to present a certificate, so each side proves its identity. Which of the following authentication methods should the engineer choose?

A city government lets employees connect personal tablets only if each tablet's operating system is patched and its antivirus is up to date. Which of the following should the security team deploy to check the tablets and move any that fail to an isolated VLAN?

reference.title: Network Access Control
reference.find: By evaluating the operating system version

questions.stem: Workstations in a company's warehouse subnet can connect to the HR department's servers, but company policy allows only the HR subnet to reach them. Which of the following should a network administrator add to enforce this policy?
An online store is adding a database server that answers queries from the store's web server. Which of the following firewall rule sets BEST reduces the database server's attack surface?

choices.text: Allow the web server's queries, then block the rest
Allow all company devices, then block the rest
Allow FTP, SSH, and the web server's queries, then block the rest
Block the ports attackers often use, then allow the rest

reference.title: Access Control Lists
reference.find: block any traffic that has not

questions.stem: After a firewall is added in front of a company's servers, users can still reach the staff portal at 10.0.8.5, but the scheduling app at 10.0.8.6 no longer loads. Based on the rules shown, which of the following would BEST fix this?

exhibit.text:
Rule Dest     Port Action
1    10.0.8.5 443  Allow
2    10.0.8.5 80   Allow
3    10.0.8.7 25   Allow

choices.text: Add an explicit deny all rule after rule 3
Add an allow rule for traffic to 10.0.8.6
Add an IPS to inspect traffic to 10.0.8.6
Move rule 3 to the top of the rule list

questions.stem: A nonprofit learns that an infected office PC is sending thousands of spam emails to addresses outside the network. Which of the following would BEST stop this?

choices.text: Add an IDS that alerts on the spam emails
Add a firewall rule that blocks incoming port 25 traffic
Add reputation-based filtering to the web proxy
Add a firewall rule that blocks outgoing port 25 traffic

questions.stem: A security team wants a system that spots attacks from the internet against the company's web servers and automatically drops the attacker's packets. Which of the following should the team deploy?

reference.title: Intrusion Detection and Prevention Systems
reference.find: block traffic from the offending source

questions.stem: A company's IDS downloads a weekly feed of patterns from known attacks and raises an alert whenever traffic matches one of them. Which of the following BEST describes how this IDS finds attacks?

reference.title: IDS and IPS Detection Methods
reference.find: database of attack patterns or signatures
